svg.title: Learning path through the 28 algorithms
svg.desc: Five stages: foundations, core classifiers, unsupervised learning, boosting and specialised methods. Each algorithm notes which earlier one to read first; the only code import is Random Forests loading the Decision Tree implementation. A panel shows that each folder holds an implementation, a guide and is covered by one smoke test.
svg.text: Numbering is the recommended reading order. Each folder holds one runnable .py file and one .md guide.
Runs every demo as a script
Fails on a non-zero exit code
Whole suite runs in about a minute
means read it after algorithm N.
means the code loads algorithm N (the only such link today).
